QuestInfo.0:
You returned to the restored tower.
Tell #bNeinheart#k what you saw.
QuestInfo.2:

Nicky, who has been chasing the tower for a long time to honor his #bfather#k's wish, seems strangely quiet about this whole thing...
QuestInfo.1: You told #bNeinheart#k about the memories you saw in the #bstatue#k.
